description.narrative:
The Radio Waumini will use the Radio to sensitize the Kenyans on the elections laws as well as mobilise and encourage large citizen’s participation in the Kenya 2013 Elections. The programme will also sensitise the citizens to eschew conflicts: Nairobi County, which has been known to be a serious flashpoint of post-elections violence in the Slums of Kibera, Mathera, Dandora will be targeted by the project which will as well utilse the Radio Waumini settlite and sister radios, such as Radio Amani, Radio Akichar,Radio Maria and Waumini Kitui.
Every week, we will allocate airtime to enable the listeners be empowered on their rights and responsibility on Elections laws, ensuring that people in the slums, women and youth are able to response through calls and Text messages. The programme also intends to sensitise to the leaders to be accountable in elections and also educate them on elections laws for the purpose of observing the very laws.
Radio Waumini work closely with the Civil Society organizations and Catholic Justice and Peace Commission for expertise on elections Acts 2011, devolved government including counties on elections processes. Church leaders who are listeners to our programme will continue spreading the messages to the faithful for peaceful elections and advocating for leaders to be accountable on elections and at all times addressing issues affecting people in the slums, women and youth.
